encoding.determinism: byte-identical /app/build/fleet_sortie_ledger.json across repeated make run on unchanged fixtures

burn_formula: fuel_cost = burn_scale * abs(isqrt(radius_dest) - isqrt(radius_src)) using integer square root
window_rule: TRANSFER_BURN allowed when open_tick <= current_tick <= close_tick inclusive
debris_rule: roll = deterministic PRNG mod 100; DEBRIS_STRIKE when roll >= debris_threshold
relay_rule: on CLOSE_SORTIE each active craft with current_tick - last_relay_tick > comm_blackout_ticks emits RELAY_LOST
claw_rule: subtract wear_per_grapple before attach; CLAW_JAMMED when claw <= 0
order_sort: ascending by seq then order_id then kind; first order_id wins duplicates counted in duplicate_orders_skipped
status_rule: RECOVERED only when CLOSE_SORTIE processed, every wreck recovered, and no fatal incident codes among FUEL_EXHAUSTED HOLD_OVERFLOW WINDOW_CLOSED DEBRIS_STRIKE RELAY_LOST CLAW_JAMMED SORTIE_TIMEOUT
policy_overrides: may replace burn_scale wear_per_grapple debris_threshold comm_blackout_ticks after sortie field defaults

may_perturb_fixtures.action: set fuel_budget to 1 then rerun make run requiring byte-identical consecutive output
set windows[0].close_tick to 0 then rerun make run requiring WINDOW_CLOSED on OWL
